description: A full-length dark blue-green court dress with a low square neckline, fitted opaque bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Muted gold knotwork-like borders define the neckline, front bodice strips, cuffs and long skirt panels. A cream inner skirt appears through the outer front opening. Round decorated metal brooches fasten the upper bodice near both shoulders; a leather-looking belt with a large round ornate buckle and small round studs secures the waist. A dark blue patterned fringed wrap hangs around the lower arms and down both sides. Brown shoes appear beneath the hem. Exact fabric fibres are uncertain.
